summary:
Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature, but nothing was executed: pytest, mypy, and black were not run, per the instructions not to run repository code.

Changes (additive only, uncommitted):
- rich/progress.py: module-level open and wrap_file after track(); Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file next to track(); private _ProgressReader (io.RawIOBase, BinaryIO), _ReadContext, and _make_read_progress helper; Literal import version-gated as in other modules; io.open used inside Progress.open because the module-level open shadows the builtin; cast(Any, mode) passes the str mode through the Literal overloads without an extra suppression.
- tests/test_progress.py: 22 new tests inserted before the __main__ block, covering the acceptance criteria.
- docs/source/progress.rst: "Reading from a file" and "Reading from a file-like object" subsections under Advanced usage.
- CHANGELOG.md: one Added bullet linking PR 1759.

Open risks: mypy --strict may flag the multiple-inheritance bases or an unused type-ignore; black formatting is unchecked; some new docstring lines exceed 88 characters, as existing docstrings do. Module-level open yields the Progress.open result, so text mode yields a TextIOWrapper.
